description.en: Certificates, contracts, source documents and verification tasks in one administration desk.
description.zh-CN: 统一管理证照、合同、原件来源和待核验事项。

boundary.en: Never replace conflicting dates with a guess. Preserve both sources and ask the owner to verify the original. Do not represent an unsigned contract or unverified certificate as approved. Draft record changes through ChangeRequests; no legal or regulatory conclusions, government submissions, or external sending.
boundary.zh-CN: 日期证据冲突时保留双方原始说法，要求负责人核对原件，不猜测有效期。未签合同和未核实证照不得标为已批准。记录修改通过变更申请；不代作法律或监管结论，不向政府或外部发送资料。

prompts.en: Review certificates and contracts expiring in the next 60 days, then draft an owner-by-owner renewal plan.
prompts.zh-CN: 检查未来 60 天到期的证照和合同，按负责人拟定续期计划。

prompts.en: Compare source documents for conflicting certificate dates and prepare verification tasks with both versions preserved.
prompts.zh-CN: 比较证照日期冲突的原件来源，保留两个版本并拟定核验待办。

job.en: Track company certificates and verified expiry dates.
job.zh-CN: 跟踪公司证照与已核实的有效期。

rows.title: Business registration / 营业登记
rows.notes: Registration scan checked against the issued original. / 已核对登记原件。

rows.title: Office fire inspection / 消防检查
rows.notes: Book a renewal inspection; no appointment confirmed. / 需预约续检，尚未确认。

rows.title: Service permit / 服务许可
rows.notes: Only a copy is available; verify the original and issuing authority. / 目前仅有复印件，需核对原件与签发机构。

rows.title: Premises occupancy / 场地使用证明
rows.notes: Archive summary says 2026-10-31; original cover says 2027-10-31. Neither date is confirmed. / 汇总为 2026-10-31，封面为 2027-10-31，两者均待确认。

job.en: Track office supplier agreements, signatures and renewal responsibilities.
job.zh-CN: 跟踪办公供应商合同、签署与续期责任。

prompts.en: Prepare the next contract renewal agenda
prompts.zh-CN: 整理下一轮合同续期议程

prompts.en: List contracts still waiting for signature

rows.title: Workspace lease / 办公租赁
rows.notes: Confirm renewal terms before 31 October. / 10 月底前确认续约条款。

rows.title: Cleaning services / 保洁服务
rows.notes: Signed copy received; monthly service review. / 已收签字件，按月检查服务。

rows.title: Equipment maintenance / 设备维护
rows.notes: Commercial review complete; supplier signature missing. / 商务审阅完成，对方尚未签署。

rows.title: Previous workspace lease / 原办公室租赁
rows.notes: Expired lease retained for traceability. / 已到期，仅作追溯归档。

job.en: Record original-document provenance without exposing private document content.
job.zh-CN: 记录原件来源，避免在公开模板泄露文件内容。

prompts.en: Which sources still need an original?

prompts.zh-CN: 追溯场地证明的冲突证据

rows.title: Registration issued copy / 登记签发件
rows.notes: Synthetic example: no attachment or real document included. / 虚构示例，不含附件或真实文件。

rows.title: Fire inspection report / 消防检查报告
rows.notes: Issued report checked; renewal work not yet started. / 已核对签发件，尚未启动续检。

rows.title: Service permit photocopy / 服务许可复印件
rows.notes: Request original before confirming validity. / 确认有效性前需取得原件。

rows.title: Occupancy cover and summary / 场地证明封面与汇总
rows.notes: Two contradictory dates retained: 2026-10-31 and 2027-10-31. / 保留两个冲突日期：2026-10-31 与 2027-10-31。

job.en: Assign evidence checks and renewal follow-up with accountable owners.
job.zh-CN: 落实证据核验与续期跟进责任。

prompts.en: Draft an owner follow-up for blocked checks
prompts.zh-CN: 为受阻核验拟定负责人跟进安排

rows.title: Resolve occupancy expiry / 核对场地证明有效期
rows.notes: Ask custodian for the complete issued document; keep both dates. / 向保管人索取完整签发件，并保留双方日期。

rows.title: Obtain service permit original / 补服务许可原件
rows.notes: Request original from the document custodian. / 向保管人索取原件。

rows.title: Schedule fire inspection renewal / 预约消防续检
rows.notes: Confirm appointment and keep acknowledgement. / 确认预约并留存回执。

rows.title: Check business registration / 核对营业登记
rows.notes: Original and archive dates agree. / 原件与归档日期一致。
